Claim 1 (Currently amended): A column assembly comprising: a chromatography column comprising a compliant seal defining a fluid passage configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit without the use of a ferrule or a threaded compression screw, wherein the compliant seal is formed of a material that allows for deformation to accommodate variations in the tapered fluid conduit.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is configured to mate with a tapered fluid conduit at a diameter of less than 0.030 inches, and the tapered portion has an included angle of less than 40 degrees.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is formed to accommodate a range of diameters of the tapered fluid conduit.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is formed of a polyimide, polyether-ether-ketone, or a deformable metal, and is configured to maintain a seal against a tapered fluid conduit at pressures up to 20,000 psi.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, further comprising a seal retainer that is removable to allow for removal and replacement of the compliant seal, wherein the seal retainer is configured to maintain the compliant seal in a sealing position against the tapered fluid conduit. 

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is configured to maintain a seal against a tapered fluid conduit at pressures up to 20,000 psi, and is formed of a material that exhibits elastic properties.
